rule0.statement: The gait walk's hind torque caps (hip 11.2125, knee 6.6375, ankle 7.4, MP 0.8875 N.m) are DOC-DERIVED: 1.25 x the doc-rounded Oku measured walk torque peaks - statics numbers with no muscle book behind them. The pulley lane (376fc92b) unblocked MEASURED wrap-geometry arm-vs-angle curves for two previously-falsified directions: knee extension (quads RF/VI/VL/VMed over the femoral-condyle cylinder, arms +17.64..+25.05 mm) and MTP flexion (FDL II-V + FHL routed over the ankle cylinder/ellipsoid, arms -15.73..-0.21 mm), SI-verified in SHAPE up to the per-taxon scalar k=0.11975394 with the absolute-scale divergence recorded. A torque cap grounded in the admitted musculature is derivable NOW: cap_j = max over the measured scan of sum_m F_m |r_m(q)|, with the forces taken from the admitted Oku walk peaks (measured) and, provisionally, the batch's PCSA x sigma law.
rule0.prediction: (1) At the deposit-geometry scale (S1), the muscle-book caps EXCEED the current doc-derived caps for both derived directions (knee and MP) under both force variants. (2) The PCSA x sigma capability variant exceeds the Oku-walk-peak variant in both directions. (3) At the SI-matched scale (S2, arms x k), the muscle-book caps COLLAPSE below 0.30x the current caps - i.e. the k divergence is not a fine-print caveat but the difference between a book that closes the walk and one that cannot power the measured stride. (4) The ankle drive admits NO measured-arm re-derivation in this lane: the admitted muscle-path record's straight-line ankle arms (the 2026-09-18-lane estimates with unresolved wraps) fall SHORT of the Oku measured walk ankle demand by >2x under both force variants - the ankle cap stays doc-derived and the ankle pulley direction is named future work. (5) The book is byte-deterministic and every number traces to a sha-pinned input.
rule0.falsifier: (a) any pre-registered delta SIGN measured opposite (recorded as FIRED with the number, never tuned); (b) any numeric band below missed by a computed cap; (c) a number in the book whose provenance chain does not resolve to a sha-verified input file and key path; (d) two full derivations disagreeing at any byte; (e) an audit table that leaves any scene drive-record number unaccounted; (f) any file changed outside tools/science_funnel/validation/hind_torque_book_20260921/. Any hit is recorded as measured.

protocol_declared.cap_law: cap_new(direction, variant) = max over the measured scan samples q of sum_m F_m(variant) x |r_m(q)|, r from the pulley deliverable's arm_samples_m (201 samples/muscle, linear index across that muscle's recorded jrange); the MAX-over-scan is the honest muscle-envelope analog of a symmetric ±cap drive clamp. No tolerance is widened anywhere; no number is tuned.

force_variants.V1_oku_walk_peaks: MEASURED-demand variant: vasti group 276.69 N distributed across VI/VL/VM by Guimaraes PCSA share (the group force is measured, the intra-group split is not; arms differ <3% across the group so the split choice is second-order - the equal-split bracket is reported alongside); RF 105.98 N on its own measured curve; FDL 204.57 N split EQUALLY across tendons II-V (one muscle, four slips, no measured partition: tau = F x mean|r|, bracketed by all-force-on-min-arm and all-force-on-max-arm bounds); FHL EXCLUDED (no Oku measurement - named gap)
force_variants.V2_pcsa_sigma: PROVISIONAL capability variant: per-muscle max_force_N straight from the record (VI 214.58, VL 737.89, VM 496.10; FDL 548.85 quarter-split; FHL 128.07 whole); inherits the sigma caveat and the 25% moment-arm uncertainty the muscle-path lane declared

protocol_declared.coverage_law: the walk's scene-side ranges (derived_zeros checks: knee -73.4..-31.5 deg, MP -0.91..+0.55 rad) are mapped against each muscle's recorded scan range; the knee sign senses agree (flexion negative in both the scene and the Wiseman model) so the knee overlap is [-45, -31.5] deg (RF/VL end at -42.3); the MTP sense mapping is ambiguous (flexion naming vs dorsiflexion drive) but the scene range CONTAINS [-30, +30] deg under EITHER mapping, so the full MTP scan is walk-reachable and the max-over-scan cap needs no extrapolation; per-muscle coverage boundaries are reported, never extrapolated through
protocol_declared.ankle_treatment: NO ankle-joint arm curve exists in the pulley deliverable (the two derived directions are knee_extension and mtp_flexion only; the FDL/FHL wrap segments are rigid during an MTP scan and their ankle contributions were provably zero there - but an ANKLE scan is exactly where they go live). The ankle section of the book is therefore CONTEXT-ONLY: the record's straight-line walking-pose ankle arms x both force variants vs the Oku measured walk ankle demand peak 5.9171 N.m; the ankle drive cap 7.4 stays doc-derived in the audit; the ankle pulley direction is named future work.
protocol_declared.consumption_map_law: order-of-magnitude deltas only: (i) the hind drive tier's clamp headroom (current caps vs demands from stance_hold.snapshot.json vs the new caps); (ii) the stance-hold ratios recomputed at the new caps; (iii) the posture/height support's feed-forward authority (the muscle-grounded ceiling the posture-cap lane's pattern gives when the knee wall is re-priced at the new knee cap). NO engine changes in this lane; the book is the future wave's input.
protocol_declared.determinism_protocol: pure function of sha-verified inputs; two in-process derivations must agree byte-for-byte on the canonical JSON, and the unittest re-invokes the script and compares sha256
